acceptanceCriteria: A single source or a CI-enforced equality check for the helper lists.
A test or check fails when the lists diverge.
body: Found 2026-10-10 in the CI critical-path lane (V1-1093). The shard job and the new go-static job copy the same isolated helper file lists, so a new helper file must be added in both places or one job silently skips it. Derive the list once or add a check that the two lists agree.
title: ci: helper-module file lists are duplicated between go-product-shard and go-static
